title: Deion Sanders and Colorado survive in overtime for first Big 12 win of the season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deion Sanders and Colorado survive in overtime for first Big 12 win of the season
sources.description: It was harder than it should have been, but Colorado and coach Deion Sanders finally have their first Big 12 win of the season, beating Kansas State 27-24 in overtime to snap a five-game losing streak.
